findings.admissionAndCleanup: Removing BeginStop from DisposeAsync leaves actual accepting handlers and stopCompletion pending when no earlier Stop initiated shutdown. A future cleanup correction must distinguish a test of terminal Dispose itself from ancillary cleanup in a transport-response test; unconditionally calling Stop first can conceal this specific Dispose contract failure.
